linked_documents.text: Benson County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 6,660 . Its county seat is Minnewaukan . The county was created on March 9 , 1883 by the Dakota Territory legislature , and was named for Bertil W. Benson , a Dakota Territory legislator at the time . The county government was organized on June 4 , 1884 , and its boundary lines were altered by two legislative actions in 1885 . White Horse Hill National Game Preserve and much of the Spirit Lake Indian Reservation are located within the county .

Burleigh County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 81,308 , making it the second-most populous county in North Dakota . Its county seat is Bismarck , the state capital . The county was named for Dakota Territory political figure Walter A. Burleigh .

Cass County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 149,778 , and was estimated to be 181,516 in 2018 . Cass County is the most populous county in North Dakota , accounting for nearly 23% of the state 's population in 2018 . Its county seat is Fargo , the most populous city in the state . Cass County is part of the Fargo , ND-MN Metropolitan Statistical Area .

Cavalier County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . It is south of the Canada-US border with Manitoba . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 3,993 . Its county seat is Langdon . The city of Cavalier is in nearby Pembina County .
Dickey County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 5,289 . Its county seat is Ellendale .
Divide County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 2,071 . Its county seat is Crosby .
East Fork Township is a civil township in Benson County , North Dakota , United States . As of the 2000 census , its population was 36 .
Eddy County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 2,385 . Its county seat is New Rockford .
Emmons County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 3,550 . Its county seat has been Linton since 1899 .
Fertile Township is a township in Walsh County , North Dakota . 51.6% ( 127 ) of the population are male , and the other 48.4% ( 119 ) are female .

Grand Forks County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , its population was 66,861 , making it the third-most populous county in North Dakota . Its county seat and largest community is Grand Forks .
Grant County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 2,394 . Its county seat is Carson .
Griggs County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 2,420 . Its county seat is Cooperstown .

Hettinger County ( /ˈhɛtɪŋɡər/ HET-ing-gər ) is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 2,477 . Its county seat is Mott . The city of Hettinger , North Dakota , is in nearby Adams County .
Kidder County is a county located in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 census , the population was 2,435 . Its county seat is Steele .
Martin Township is a township in Walsh County , North Dakota .

McKenzie County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 6,360 . Its county seat is Watford City . Between 2010 and 2018 , according to Census Bureau estimates , it was the fastest growing county in the United States , growing 114.3 percent . The county lies immediately adjacent to the Williston Micropolitan Statistical Area , although the Census Bureau does not include McKenzie County in that grouping .
McLean County ( /məˈkleɪn/ mə-KLAYN ) is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 8,962 . Its county seat is Washburn .

Mountrail County is a county in the northwestern part of North Dakota , United States . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 7,673 . Its county seat is Stanley . The county was originally created in 1873 , then removed in 1892 , annexed by Ward County . It was re-created and organized in 1909 . Oil production from the Bakken formation in the early 21st century has attracted workers and reversed decades of population decline in the county . From 2010 to 2015 , especially , population has markedly increased , creating its own strains .
Nelson County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 3,126 . Its county seat is Lakota .
Pierce County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 4,357 . Its county seat is Rugby .
Ramsey County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 11,451 . Its county seat is Devils Lake .
Ransom County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 5,457 . Its county seat is Lisbon .

Sheridan County is a county located in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 census , the population was 1,321 , making it the third-least populous county in North Dakota . Its county seat is McClusky .

Stutsman County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 21,100 . Its county seat is Jamestown . The Jamestown , North Dakota Micropolitan Statistical Area includes all of Stutsman County .
Traill County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census listed the population at 8,121 . Its county seat is Hillsboro , and its largest city is Mayville .
Walsh County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 11,119 . Its county seat is Grafton .
Wells County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 4,207 . Its county seat is Fessenden .

Williams County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota . As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 22,398 . Its county seat is Williston . Between 2010 and 2018 , according to Census Bureau estimates , it was the second fastest growing county in the United States , trailing only neighboring McKenzie County , to its south . The Williston Micropolitan Statistical Area includes all of Williams County . The Micropolitan Statistical Area is the fastest-growing Primary Statistical Area , growing 57.8% in population from 2010 to 2018 . In 2014 , Williams County had the lowest percentage of unemployed people of any county in the United States , at 1.2 percent .
